verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets first-party AI agents for customer screening, ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring that work on the customer's own alert data. They auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases, which is a form of AI-generated assessment inside the product. The evidence is thin marketing-page fragments, though, and describes automated actions rather than insights or suggestions shown to the user. missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights/explanations surfaced to users, AI suggestions or recommendations on cases/alerts, in-depth docs on agent outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent
high-risk or complex cases are automatically escalated for human expert review.
